| Jg - Watch out for cc chain, dodging one q can win you the fight. He's a bit of a threat early game but so long as he can't get a lead anywhere he's dealable. He cant out scale you so he'll look to out gank you. Just counter-gank if 2v2 / 3v3 is good or trade resources.

| Top - A case of you will likely never kill her but she'll never kill you pre 6. You have a slight advantage if you're able to weave q's effectively without tanking her true damage. Post 6 avoid anywhere that isn't your turret as she will just jump on you with R and out duel you.

| Top/Mid - Can't fight her when there's low minions, have to bully her early with q poke and aa procs while minions aren't in a dangerous position. Unless for some reason she's incredibly low, use your W exclusively for defensive reasons such as dodging her E or escaping after she engages. She can and will turret dive you the moment she gets the chance, even with the slightest lead while your on 70% hp, a good way to win these turret dive fights is to be continuously moving around and forcing her to stick to you with q. For instance, if she E-Q-R or R-Q-E you under tower, W-AA her the moment you get out of stun, run to make distance and let the turret do the work, once she uses her Q again while you have no passive, R or flash as far away from her as possible while staying under tower, if she continues to chase you, W-Q-AA her when you're confident it'll kill her. If it's early game and you managed to execute it properly Irelia is either dead or retreating on 1hp, if it's later in the game you might need to alter a few steps to get the job done. For instance, if you have flash then use R on her instead and use flash to escape, so long as you dont hit her W this will likely result in a kill or her retreating so long as she isn't incredibly ahead.
